name: surface-runtime-sidecar-failure-listener-order
description: The first sidecar send of a window registers the listener of sidecar-failure; the host settles that registration after the test releases it, and only then receives the sidecarSend call.
reason: The registration of a listener belongs to a page, which the Go producer does not have (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
